stories.title: 'Flying focus' laser overcomes key limitation in plasma-based particle accelerators
stories.desc: In a new Nature Physics study, researchers accelerated electrons to more than twice the energy predicted by the traditional dephasing limit for laser-plasma accelerators operating over the same distance. This was made possible by a specially engineered laser pulse called a flying focus, which…
